text:
jess: hitting duplicate webhook deliveries when token refresh and 429 happen together in the onboarding sample.

omar: can you share the minimal repro?

jess: 1) start request, 2) token expires mid-request, 3) server returns 429, 4) client retries immediately and webhook fires twice.

lee: looks like no idempotency header in sample. two quick fixes: add Idempotency-Key: <req-id> in sample and add tiny randomized backoff when 429 follows a refresh.

omar: SDK parity note: node has jitter, python retries immediately. open a parity issue please.

jess: will open PR for sample (enable replay-guard by default) + a test harness that fakes refresh.

lee: add telemetry metric dx.replay_guard.blocked (emit only req id).

dx-bot: created ticket DX-980 and labelled it dx/dup-on-429.

omar: thanks, patch and tests asap; keep SDK option opt-in to avoid surprising advanced users.
